first_page_excerpt: RV-3032-C7 Real-Time Clock Module with I2C-Bus DIMENSIONS Package: Recommended Solder Pad: 0,9 3,2 0,9 0,9 0,9 0,4 0,8 0,5 1,5 0,8 0,5 0,4 0,8 max 0,15 3,2 Metal lid is connected to VSS (pin #5) All dimensions in mm typical APPLICATIONS DESCRIPTION IoT Metering Industrial Automotive Health Care Wearables, Portables The RV-3032-C7 is a SMD Real-Time Clock Module that incorporates an integrated CMOS circuit together with an XTAL. It operates under vacuum in a hermetically sealed ceramic package with metal lid. FEATURES Ultra low power consumption: 160 nA @ 3 V Wide operating voltage range: 1.3 V
